newsitem.title: USA: Prodigy commits $12.5 mln for expansion in Africa.
newsitem.headline: Prodigy commits $12.5 mln for expansion in Africa.

text.p: Prodigy Inc, the online service, said Thursday it had committed $12.5 million in 1997 to expand its Internet activities in Africa.
Prodigy's Internet provider, Africa Online, said it will expand to Tanzania and Uganda in May, and plans to start up in Egypt and South Africa by year-end.

"We have been operating successful Internet services in Africa since 1994, which is when we established our first office in Nairobi. That operation is now profitable," said Paul DeLacey, Prodigy president and chief executive.
Prodigy's Africa Online has offices in Nairobi and Mombasa, Kenya; Accra, Ghana; and Abidjan, Ivory Coast.
The company said it has increased its market share in Kenya to 85 percent from zero since 1996 and expects to see more growth across the continent.

"By the end of 1997, we expect Prodigy and Africa Online to be positioned to expand services beyond our core base of regional hubs into every major market on the continent," said Paul Tucker, senior vice president of Prodigy International.
